description: This file contains unit tests for serializing and normalizing models using the ModelTrait in the OrangeHRM core API. It defines multiple test classes and entity classes to verify behavior of model transformations, nested array creation, and filter/attribute configurations.

classes.name: ModelTraitTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing serialization and model behaviors in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: TestJobTitleEntity
classes.description: A mock entity class representing a job title with properties for name and description.

classes.name: TestEmployeeEntity
classes.description: A mock entity class representing an employee with an ID and an associated JobTitle entity.

classes.name: TestJobTitleModel
classes.description: A test model implementing Normalizable, using ModelTrait, for testing serialization of job title entities.

classes.name: TestEmployeeModel
classes.description: A test model implementing Normalizable, using ModelTrait, for testing serialization of employee entities.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A minimal test class implementing Normalizable with ModelTrait, used for testing internal makeNestedArray method.

methods.name: testSetEntity
methods.description: Tests setting an entity and converting it to an array, verifying the name property serialization.

methods.name: testSetFilters
methods.description: Tests setting specific filters on the model to restrict output to specified fields.

methods.name: testSetAttributeNames
methods.description: Tests changing attribute names and verifying correct mapping and output.

methods.name: testToArrayWithChaining
methods.description: Verifies nested entity serialization and attribute/filter configuration via method chaining.

methods.name: testMakeNestedArray
methods.description: Tests the private method 'makeNestedArray' used for constructing nested arrays from paths.
